profile.headline: Principal Staff Software Engineer at LinkedIn
profile.summary: Technical leader building and maintaining amazing mobile experiences.

positions.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer
positions.description: Leader on a team building client infrastructure that helps empower our developers to make LinkedIn a delightful experience for all of our members.

positions.title: Technical Director
positions.description:
Principal Investigator for NextGen's drone efforts, these projects include research to embed autonomous environmentally aware routing functionality into existing drone systems, and designing the next generation of mobile reconnaissance sensors. Responsibilities include building and leading agile teams of engineers and researchers through all aspects of product research, design and development.

Additionally, I utilized my technical expertise to lead integrated software solutions spanning a wide range of technologies with a focus on aerospace and weather domains. Involved in all areas of project planning, execution, testing and delivery.

positions.title: Senior Mobile Developer
positions.description: Worked across iOS and Android to develop cutting edge 360 degree video technology.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Gained experience in all phases of the software life-cycle. Worked closely with customers to develop requirement specifications and acquire consensus among stakeholders. Gathered a wide range of technical experience spanning multiple languages and environments. Recommended and implemented agile development process improvements.  Held technical leadership and mentoring roles.

certifications.name: Confronting Bias: Thriving Across Our Differences
certifications.title: Confronting Bias: Thriving Across Our Differences

projects.title: Bluejay
projects.description: Technical lead for an agile team developing a revolutionary in-flight moving map product.  Project included the development of a server-side component as well as both a web and mobile client.  Technologies include: Java, objective-c, iOS, Javascript, HTML5, CSS3.

projects.title: In Flight Entertainment
projects.description: A lead developer on a 3D in-flight entertainment solution developed with .NET technologies.  Played a crucial role in all aspects of the development process.
